R325.note: @require_POST puts the delete back under CsrfViewMiddleware (enabled in settings.py), but with urls.py and the template untouched the existing GET link at /account/delete/ now returns 405 and the new confirm view renders a template that does not exist; the write-up states this as a required follow-up rather than doing it, though urls.py was in the case directory.

R326.note: Placeholder plus the queryForObject(sql, RowMapper, Object...) overload binds orderNumber as a parameter; nothing else changes.

R327.note: Passing reportsDir as the root option makes Express/send resolve and contain the name (403 on escape); the missing-parameter 400 and served file for legitimate names are unchanged.

R328.note: Rendering the description as a JSX text child restores React escaping; the div-to-p swap is stated, the field is documented as plain text, and no legitimate use is lost.

R329.note: Content sniffing via python-magic, extension from the allowlist and a uuid name close the vector, but the fix also adds a 5 MB MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH cap the original never had and the explanation does not mention it, so uploads the original accepted can now be rejected with 413; the changed returned path is stated.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks on both base and target followed by a segment-aware containment check and a read of the resolved path closes the planted-symlink escape; regular files inside uploadsDir read as before and missing files still surface as a not-exist PathError (residual check-then-read race noted but not a contract change).

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity does activate the existing @PreAuthorize rules, but the write-up's SecurityConfig.java silently overwrites the case's existing SecurityConfig and drops its SecurityFilterChain bean (anyRequest().authenticated()), leaving URL-level security to Boot's auto-config fallback with different login behaviour, while claiming the class is new.

R332.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT and adding LIBXML_NONET closes the XXE, but the new DOCTYPE rejection throws an uncaught InvalidArgumentException (500, no JSON) for well-formed submissions carrying a DTD that the original parsed, a restriction the stated contract does not call for.

R333.note: @actor bound via Parameters.AddWithValue keeps apostrophes as literal actor names and the count JSON shape unchanged.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) supplies the no-reservation default at the lookup and preserves onHand minus stored count for present SKUs.

R335.note: Canonical File resolution against TESTFILES_DIR with a Path.startsWith containment check closes traversal and symlink escape; legitimate simple names open the same file and the echoed name only differs where TESTFILES_DIR itself is non-canonical.

R336.note: Direct argv exec with -- before host closes both shell and flag injection, but the added 30 s CommandContext timeout is a new limit the original did not have: a traceroute of 15 hops with a few unresponsive hops (3 probes x 5 s each) routinely exceeds 30 s and now returns 500, and the write-up presents it only as hardening.

R337.note: Dropping envp so the child inherits the server environment removes the attacker-controlled environment entirely; the inherited-environment change is stated and the header had no legitimate role.
